text: Code reviews are an essential practice in software development, where team members examine each other's code before it is added to the main project. This process is crucial for catching bugs early, as a fresh pair of eyes often spots mistakes that the original writer missed. Beyond fixing errors, code reviews promote knowledge sharing within the team. Junior developers learn from more experienced colleagues, and everyone gains a better understanding of different parts of the system. This collaborative habit ultimately raises the overall quality of the team's work, ensuring that code is cleaner, more maintainable, and consistent across the project.
